text:
Predicates:
OlympicEvent(x) ::: x is a summer Olympic games.
Last(x) ::: x is the last of its kind.
Location(x, y) ::: x took place in y.
WonMostMedals(x, y) ::: x won the most medals in event y.
UnitedStates(x) ::: x is the United States.
Premises:
OlympicEvent(summerOlympics) ::: The summer Olympic games is a sporting event.
Last(summerOlympics) ::: The last summer Olympic games was in Tokyo.
Location(summerOlympics, Tokyo) ::: The United States won the most medals in Tokyo.
Conclusion:
WonMostMedals(UnitedStates, summerOlympics) ::: The United States won the most medals in the last summer Olympic games.
